#!/bin/bash
# Flux job script translated from PBS

# The PBS 'nodes' and 'ppn' requests are combined with the 'aprun -n' task count.
# 64 nodes, 16 tasks per node (1024 total tasks), and 1 CPU per task (default).
#flux: -N 64
#flux: --ntasks-per-node=16
#flux: -c 1

#flux: -q high
#flux: -t 1:00:00
#flux: --job-name=select_neurotrees

# The original script specified separate output and error files.
# Flux merges stderr with stdout by default when a single output file is specified.
# The '$PBS_JOBID' variable is replaced with Flux's '{job.id}'.
#flux: -o ./results/neurotrees_select.{job.id}.out

# The PBS node feature request ':xe' is translated to a Flux constraint.
#flux: -C xe

# The PBS umask directive does not have a standard Flux equivalent and is omitted.
# A 'umask' command can be added to the script body if needed.
# #PBS -W umask=0027

# Ensure the output directory exists
mkdir -p ./results

module swap PrgEnv-cray PrgEnv-gnu
module load cray-hdf5-parallel

set -x

# The Flux equivalent of $PBS_O_WORKDIR is $FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR
cd $FLUX_SUBMIT_DIR

# 'aprun' is replaced by 'flux run'. It will launch the 1024 tasks requested.
flux run ./build/neurotrees_select -p GC -i 256 --reindex \
      --cachesize=$((4 * 1024 * 1024)) \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_extended_20171019_compressed.h5 \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_reindex_20170615.dat \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_20171019.h5

reasons: Validation failed at directive: --ntasks-per-node=16. It is often more robust to specify the total number of tasks for the job, e.g., '-n 1024', which, when combined with '-N 64', ensures the correct distribution.
Validation failed at directive: -C xe. Node feature names like 'xe' are defined by the local site configuration and cannot be validated generically.
issues: The script contains multiple hardcoded, project-specific absolute paths for the application's input files. This makes the script non-portable and it will fail if the directory structure changes.

#!/bin/bash
### set the number of nodes and the number of PEs per node
#PBS -l nodes=64:ppn=16:xe
### which queue/account to use
#PBS -q high
### set the wallclock time
#PBS -l walltime=1:00:00
### set the job name
#PBS -N select_neurotrees
### set the job stdout and stderr
#PBS -e ./results/neurotrees_select.$PBS_JOBID.err
#PBS -o ./results/neurotrees_select.$PBS_JOBID.out
### set email notification
##PBS -m bea
### Set umask so users in my group can read job stdout and stderr files
#PBS -W umask=0027

module swap PrgEnv-cray PrgEnv-gnu
module load cray-hdf5-parallel

set -x

cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR

aprun -n 1024 ./build/neurotrees_select -p GC -i 256 --reindex \
      --cachesize=$((4 * 1024 * 1024)) \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_extended_20171019_compressed.h5 \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_reindex_20170615.dat \
      /projects/sciteam/baef/Full_Scale_Control/DGC_forest_20171019.h5
